title: Svenska Kraftnät NUP — 10-year transmission grid project (10-årsplan nätinvestering)
description: One record per project line in the per-region tables of NUP §10-årsplan nätinvesteringar (printed pages 72-103). Each record represents either a station project or a line project in the Swedish transmission grid, classified by decision phase (under consideration / preparation / construction) and primary motivation (connection / market_integration / system_reinforcement / reinvestment). The same project may appear in multiple region tables when it crosses regions; each occurrence is captured as a separate record with a unique project_key composed of region short code + kartnr. Deduplication by kartnr happens at SQL load time via the project_aliases table from migration 007. This dataset is staged as a single CSV under data/extracted/_review/svk_nup_transmission_project.csv rather than per-record JSON files because the source is highly tabular and the volume is high (~290 rows).

project_key.description: Stable snake_case ASCII key. Format: svk_<region_short>_<kartnr>. Region shorts: nbn=Norrbotten, vbn=Västerbotten, vnl=Västernorrland, jmt=Jämtland Härjedalen, gvl=Gävleborg, orb=Örebro/Dalarna/Värmland, sth=Stockholm, srm=Sörmland/Östergötland, vmd=Västmanland/Uppsala, hal=Halland/V.Götaland, krn=Kronoberg/Kalmar/Jönköping/Gotland, ska=Skåne/Blekinge.

kartnr.description: Map number from source (Kartnr column). Numeric string; preserved as string because some source rows reuse the same kartnr for sub-projects (e.g. Skåne 11173 covers six related sub-projects under one Hyllinge map number).

project_description.description: Original Swedish project description as printed (Projektbeskrivning column).

region.description: Source-published region heading the project is listed under (proper noun in original Swedish, e.g. 'Region Norrbotten', 'Regionerna Sörmland och Östergötland').

bidding_zones.description: Bidding zones the region overlaps. Multiple if region spans more than one zone.

decision_phase.description: under_consideration = source 'Under övervägande' (investigation in progress, no decision yet). preparation = source 'Förberedelsefas' (between directional decision and final go decision; includes detailed engineering and procurement). construction = source 'Entreprenadfas' (decision taken to start execution and sign main contract; project rarely cancelled at this stage).

motivation.description: connection = source 'Anslutning' (driven by external connection request). market_integration = 'Marknadsintegration' (cross-zone or international trade capacity). system_reinforcement = 'Systemförstärkning' (driven by internal capacity / driftsäkerhet need). reinvestment = 'Reinvestering' (driven by end of technical lifetime / replacement).

planned_year_min.description: Earliest year the facility is planned to be taken into or out of service. Null when source shows '*' (under utredning, year not yet decided).

planned_year_max.description: Latest year if source shows a range (e.g. '2030-2031', '2035-2040'). Equal to planned_year_min when source shows a single year.

planned_year_raw.description: Original source string in the 'Planerad att tas i/ur drift' column, preserved verbatim.

in_or_out_of_service.description: in_service when project is new construction/expansion. out_of_service when project is a 'rivning' (demolition) of an existing facility. Source column is 'Planerad att tas i/ur drift' and the project_description usually clarifies; rivning rows are out_of_service.
